newsitem.title: USA: Citibank introduces ATM for in-line skaters.
newsitem.headline: Citibank introduces ATM for in-line skaters.

text.p: Citibank is setting up a new automated teller machine for in-line skaters that will debut next week in Miami Beach's trendy South Beach oceanfront district.

A pink ramp will lead bank-bound skaters from the sidewalk to the ATM, located alongside two drive-through ATMs for cars. Special signs depicting in-line skates will guide the skaters to the ATM and its lane will be narrower than the others to keep cars out.

"It's the first ATM, as far as we know, in the nation specially for rollerbladers," branch manager Rolando Hernandez said. The in-line ATM also is expected to keep skaters off the branch's marble floors.
Miami Beach is the test market for an idea that Citibank may eventually try at other branches across the nation, he said.

In-line skating has not always been well received in crowded South Beach, where business owners complain of skaters barrelling dangerously through crowds. "There are a lot of businesses that won't let them in," Hernandez said.
In-line skating and roller hockey are among the fastest-growing sports in the United States.
